## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `composer validate --strict --no-check-lock`
- [ ] `composer lint`
- [ ] Relevant WordPress integration tests
- [ ] `composer build` and the ZIP package was inspected

## Checklist

- [ ] The change preserves WordPress capability and MCP scope checks.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and the changelog are updated when applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, production data, or generated release artifacts are committed.
